component.name: DeeCure
component.summary: Understand your Linux computer and fix it safely

description.p: DeeCure looks at your whole computer: hardware, the operating system, apps, services, storage, networks, and security. It explains what it finds in plain words, and tells you what needs attention first.

ul.li: A health score and a short list of problems, most serious first
Safe fixes with a preview of every step, a check that they worked, and undo
A timeline of what changed: updates, config files, devices, boots, and crashes
A warning before the disk is full, from the last week's history
Live performance charts, processes, sensors, battery health, and disks
Security and privacy checks that need no password
Notifications for serious problems, quiet hours, and a weekly summary
A performance check that finds why the computer is slow

description.p: Everything stays on this computer. There is no account, and nothing is sent anywhere.
First release: every page shows real data from this computer, with safe fixes, a what-changed timeline, disk forecasts, notifications, and a weekly summary.
